title: sedum ochroleucum subsp. montanum
intro: Sedum ochroleucum subsp. montanum, commonly known as Mountain Yellow Sedum, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum ochroleucum subsp. montanum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its potential as a treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
